record.paper_title: Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs
record.original_question: Characterize the graphs G for which the inequality ⌊diam(G)/2⌋ ≤ ψ_q(G) holds.

evidence.quote: 5. Since every tree T satisﬁes⌊diam(T )/2⌋≤ ψq(T ) (see Proposition 1.5), characterize the graphs G for which ⌊diam(G)/2⌋≤ ψq(G).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G = (V, E) be a finite simple graph. For a vertex v ∈ V, let N[v] denote the closed neighborhood of v (i.e. v together with its neighbors in G). A partition π = {V_1, V_2, …, V_k} of V into nonempty color classes is called a quorum coloring of G if, for every vertex v ∈ V, at least half of the vertices in N[v] belong to the same color class as v. The quorum coloring number ψ_q(G) is defined as the maximum number k of classes in any quorum coloring of G. Let diam(G) denote the diameter of G (assumed connected).

It is known that every tree T satisfies ⌊diam(T)/2⌋ ≤ ψ_q(T). Provide a characterization of the connected graphs G for which the inequality
   ⌊diam(G)/2⌋ ≤ ψ_q(G)
holds.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of characterizing graphs G satisfying ⌊diam(G)/2⌋ ≤ ψ_q(G) appears to remain open. The 2021 work proposing solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings does not appear to resolve this characterization, and follow-up work (e.g. on complexity of quorum coloring problems and a 2023 arXiv paper on linear-time quorum coloring) does not report a full characterization. No source identified provides such a characterization.

status_evidence.snippet: Discusses open problems including the relation between ⌊diam(G)/2⌋ and ψ_q(G).

status_evidence.title: Quorum coloring of maximum cardinality in linear time
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2023) work on quorum colorings focusing on algorithmic aspects, no characterization given.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization problem remains unresolved in subsequent literature.
